purpose: Twelve-character mixed value — long-alnum rule territory.

groundTruth.rationale: A 12-character mixed alphanumeric password in the userinfo slot is still a credential; the LONG-alnum rule owns 12+ and must report it. The new 8-11 rule must stay silent (disjoint window) — a match by it would be double-reporting.

limitations: Disjoint-window pin: DPK-SEC-063 (12+ alnum) reports; DPK-SEC-108 (8-11) must not.

provenance.writtenFor: Phase 9 Workstream C GAP-013 short userinfo passwords
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
